items.label: Multifunctional Electronics Wall Mount
items.value: This universal wall Mount fits holds up to 22 lb and 1.57 inch thick devices. Such as Laptop/ Keyboard/ Tablet/ Kindle/ Router/ Modem/ Cable Box/ Cellphone and More Small and Wide Devices. You can also use it to store your cutting board on the wall. You just need to check the size and weight of your device before buying.

items.label: Two-Tier Shelf Design
items.value: Your devices will be stored in multiple ways. For example you can store one laptop & one keyboard at the same time, or two laptops, or two keyboards, or four tablets, or one modem & one WIFI router, or two tablets & two cellphones, or two cutting boards and more.

items.label: High Quality Metal Material
items.value: Our office storage organizer is made of 1.5 mm high quality metal and surface painting process. It contains 8 pcs EVA pads to protect your electronics.

items.label: Multiple Scenarios
items.value: You can use the cable box mount to keep your small and wide Devices on the wall, such as living room/bedroom/study room/office. You can also display the keyboard in your store and use it to store your cutting board on the wall.
